q-0412.answer:
Surah Al-Ankaboot (29) — The Spider · 69 ayahs · Meccan

Main teachings:
• Only to see – because seeing has to do with what is there, but knowledge is broader than seeing, since it includes what is not present as well as what is.
• One of those who will be destroyed, because she used to support them in their disbelief and wrongdoing.
• Those who turn away from the truth, turning a blind eye to clear evidence, being stubborn and arrogant.
• He will make know which are sincere in their claim to be believers from those who are lying.

q-0661.answer:
Surah Ash-Shams (91) — The Sun · 15 ayahs · Meccan

Main teachings:
• He showed him to his transgression and his Taqwa.
• He made the punishment descend upon them all equally.
• To conceal it. This means that he makes it dull, and he disregards it by neglecting to allow it to receive guidance.
• Do not transgress against her in her drinking, for she has been allocated a day to drink and you have been allocated a day to drink, as is known to you.
• When it covers the sun, which takes place when sun disappears and the horizons become dark.

Full ayah text and tafsir are available in the sources below.

Quran 58:6 — Al-Mujaadila (The Pleading Woman)

يَوْمَ يَبْعَثُهُمُ ٱللَّهُ جَمِيعًۭا فَيُنَبِّئُهُم بِمَا عَمِلُوٓا۟ ۚ أَحْصَىٰهُ ٱللَّهُ وَنَسُوهُ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍۢ شَهِيدٌ

Transliteration: Yawma yab'asuhumul laahu jamee'an fayunabbi'uhum bimaa 'amiloo; ahsaahul laahu wa nasooh; wallaahu 'alaa kulli shai'in shaheed

Translation: On the Day when Allah will resurrect them all and inform them of what they did. Allah had enumerated it, while they forgot it; and Allah is, over all things, Witness.
